scope: Pure coordinate, debug-truth external-odometry conversion, and ROS simulation clock to PX4 timestamp mapping core only.

coordinate_conversion: epoch/frame-checked ENU PositionCommand to PX4 NED
NED translation offset for an explicitly paired local origin
ROS ENU/FLU quaternion to PX4 NED/FRD quaternion
external VehicleOdometry field conversion with explicit positive variances
time_mapping: least-squares ROS /clock to host monotonic mapping using observed clock rate
sample age computed in wall time rather than equating simulation and PX4 time
host system time translated with PX4 TimesyncStatus estimated_offset
rejects stale or regressed ROS clock, stale/high-RTT PX4 timesync, out-of-history samples, excessive age, poor fit, and out-of-range clock rate
timestamp_sample_us must be explicitly mapped before external odometry conversion
